chapter: Baton Rouge, marriage, learning to play
title: Baton Rouge band with Tony Fougerat, Fliver Ford and Mutt Powers
summary: Restaurant and spot jobs in Baton Rouge with Fougerat, Powers, Fliver Ford and J.B. Landry; a photo of his son Ted.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Left there, after finishing there I got a job with a band in Baton Rouge playing in a restaurant. And we were playing spot jobs in Baton Rouge with Mutt Powers and Fliver Ford and Tony Fougerat. Oh yeah?
Fliver Ford. That's a great name, Fliver Ford. Yeah, Fliver Ford.
His name was, his real name you would never guess was Jewel.

Yeah. So everybody called him Fliver. One of the funniest characters that I ever knew in my life. He was a constant laugh. Died very young, dropped dead. J.B. Landry was in the band. Freddie, some played banjo.
One instrument? Fliver played guitar and banjo. Freddie, whatever his name, I can't remember his name, saved my life. He was the original banjo player in that band. Then Fliver Ford took his place.
Well I'm getting confused on who played what instrument. Is it J.B.
Landry? J.B. Landry played alto sax. Tony Fougerat played trumpet. Mutt Powers played drums. Fliver Ford played banjo and I played piano. And that was the band.
Oh, they're on that phonograph? Uh huh.
Those are my two granddaughters. And that's my youngest son there. That's when he graduated from De La Salle High School. He's graduated already from New Orleans University.
Okay, and you have a... He's a paramedic in the New Orleans Fire Department. Uh huh. Been there nearly eight years now. Uh huh. Got a fine job at the New Orleans Fire Department.
